text.p: Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie AG broke down its nine-month pre-tax profit, earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) and sales as follows:
- Wall, ceiling and roofing systems sales rose 42.1 percent to 5.805 billion schillings, EBIT fell 12.5 percent to 784 million and pre-tax profit fell 36.7 percent to 540 million.
- Pipe systems and draining technology sales rose 3.4 percent to 2.818 billion schillings, EBIT rose 5.3 percent to 221 million and pre-tax fell 5.2 percent to 160 million.
- Treibacher sales fell 20.9 percent to 2.626 billion schillings, EBIT rose 28.8 percent to 152 million and pre-tax rose 69.1 percent to 121 million.
- Real estate sales rose 29.1 percent to 408 million schillings, EBIT fell 7.4 percent to 163 million and pre-tax rose 4.8 percent to 220 million. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
